sources.label: App patches by Dudek, for use with Morphe.
sources.author: Dudek
patch_list: Routes Calendar token requests and invalidation through MicroG-RE 7.1.1+. Requires Google Play services and the same account in Android and MicroG-RE.
Rebuilds schedule widget row contents on Android 16+ to work around missing tiles, deformed tile backgrounds and recycled layout corruption. Intended for Realme UI 7. Does not reset the widget.
